title: Country source packs: Nepal plus four LDC countries (batch 1)
framing: These are source packs for research. No real pilot is selected, no beneficiary outcome is asserted, no mission or task was activated, and no message was sent to any institution. Every material statement below is either (a) a dated primary-source reading recorded with its exact URL and source location, (b) a bounded UN Comtrade / World Bank preview retained byte-for-byte with a checksum, or (c) an explicit research question or evidence gap.

scope.productAndDestinationScope: One tightly scoped origin-product-corridor per country, recorded as a research corridor rather than a shipment plan.
scope.excluded: No country-wide investment ranking, no multi-product programme, no buyer list, no tariff schedule reproduced, no cost model, no legal advice.

selectionRationale.statement: Nepal is the anchor required by the task. The four added countries were chosen from the 44 LDC entries in catalog/countries.json for maximum legitimate diversity of region, corridor and regulator while each has an independent published national statistical/agricultural institution and a distinct, documented export corridor.
criteria: Each is an LDC flag in the dated M49 snapshot retained in catalog/countries.json (retrieved 2026-10-11).
Each has a reachable official agriculture ministry and a national statistics instance that could be read directly.
Each pairs a different region with a different single corridor so the five packs do not duplicate one another.
Each has at least one bounded, checkable trade observation or an explicit, recorded provider gap.
selectionRationale.graduationCaveat: LDC status is a dated statistical snapshot, not a political statement. Bangladesh is scheduled to graduate from LDC status and Cambodia and Senegal have their own graduation timelines; treat the ldc flag as a snapshot and refresh before relying on it.

sharedDatasetProviders.name: World Bank World Development Indicators (API v2, source 2)
sharedDatasetProviders.access: Reachable; retained snapshots exist in catalog/agriculture-statistics.json (retrieved 2026-10-11) and, for Senegal only, in docs/research/country-packs/sources/statistics/ (retrieved 2026-10-12).
sharedDatasetProviders.license: World Bank data terms and CC BY 4.0 attribution are recorded per series in the catalog; original providers identified per indicator.
sharedDatasetProviders.caveat: Annual sector context only. The agriculture value-added series includes forestry and fishing and is not crop revenue or export earnings. Dataset update dates are not observation dates.

sharedDatasetProviders.name: UN Comtrade public annual preview API
sharedDatasetProviders.access: Reachable without an API key; returns a bounded subset. Raw responses for successful bounded queries are retained under docs/research/country-packs/sources/trade/ with SHA256 checksums and a manifest.
sharedDatasetProviders.license: UN Comtrade data-use policy applies; no blanket reuse licence is asserted and attribution is retained.
sharedDatasetProviders.caveat: A zero-row preview is an evidence gap, not zero trade. Historical trade does not establish current buyer demand, supplier capacity, shipment eligibility, price or financing.

sharedDatasetProviders.name: FAOSTAT
sharedDatasetProviders.access: Landing application reachable; the JavaScript interface yields no parsed production table text on a plain read, and catalog/agriculture-workflows.json records that the FAOSTAT API host (fenixservices.fao.org) was not reachable from this environment.
sharedDatasetProviders.caveat: No FAOSTAT production/yield/trade numbers are quoted in these packs; extracting them remains an open task.

sharedDatasetProviders.name: ITC Market Analysis Tools (Trade Map, Market Access Map, Export Potential Map)
sharedDatasetProviders.access: Direct read returned HTTP 403 (access restricted) in this batch; catalog/agriculture-workflows.json already records the same 403 and notes account/plan restrictions.
sharedDatasetProviders.caveat: No ITC figures are quoted. Export-potential outputs are modelled opportunities, not confirmed demand.

sharedDatasetProviders.name: WTO ePing SPS/TBT platform and dataset
sharedDatasetProviders.caveat: A notification or an enquiry point is a regulatory contact, not a buyer and not proof of the complete current law.

sharedDatasetProviders.name: UNSD M49 countries or areas
sharedDatasetProviders.access: Retained snapshot: catalog/countries.json (retrieved 2026-10-11, 248 entries, 44 with the LDC flag).
sharedDatasetProviders.caveat: A statistical catalog of countries or areas, not a list of sovereign states or UN members.

agricultureBaseline.nationalStatisticsRoute: National Statistics Office, Thapathali, Kathmandu (https://nsonepal.gov.np/, read 2026-10-12) publishes official indices and survey releases. A retained MoALD statistical yearbook series (e.g. Statistical Information on Nepalese Agriculture) is the conventional national agriculture baseline but was not downloaded in this batch.

routes.whatToVerify: Current exporter registration/export-licence route and the authority that issues it; a Nepal cabinet decision of 2082-09-04 printed on the Department of Customs home page (retrieved 2026-10-12) changed certain customs transit/routing arrangements, so any checklist must be re-dated.
Whether the Department of Food Technology and Quality Control export certificate is required for the specific tea grade and destination, and its current fee/validity.

routes.route: Preferential India access under the Nepal-India trade treaty
routes.whatToVerify: The current consolidated treaty text, any amendment, and the applicable Indian customs notification. catalog/agriculture-pilot.json records that the published Nepal treaty text provides certificate-of-origin arrangements but that no current shipment tariff or exemption was confirmed.
routes.evidence: https://www.tepc.gov.np/pages/treaty-of-trade-india (indexed official extract recorded 2026-10-11; direct fetch not re-verified in this batch)

routes.route: Indian destination-side import clearance for tea
routes.whatToVerify: Which edition of the Tea Board India directive applies to the shipment date, and whether FSSAI testing route and notified laboratory are valid for that grade.
routes.evidence: catalog/agriculture-pilot.json sources tea-directive-01, tea-corrigendum, tea-directive-02 and tea-labs (all 2026-dated official Tea Board India PDFs, retrieved 2026-10-11).

marketAccessQuestions: Which exact Nepal tea grade, packaging and border point is in scope, and does the India tea-import SOP for that grade apply at the intended shipment date? (Directive 02/2026 supersedes the earlier directive and corrigendum, so older checklists need reconciliation.)
What is the current, consolidated Nepal-India preferential tariff and certificate-of-origin requirement for the scoped grade?
Is a Nepal-issued phytosanitary or food-safety certificate required for the destination and product form, and which body issues it?
Are there current Indian SPS/TBT notifications specific to processed tea that add requirements beyond the Tea Board directive?
What evidence, if any, exists for actual buyer demand rather than a procedural notice? (See evidenceGaps; none was established.)
